description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Kandiah Sivanesan as a member of Northern Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Northern Province Provincial Council due to a member's death. It details the process under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, including the failure of a political party to nominate a candidate and the subsequent declaration of a new member by the Commissioner of Elections. The core subject matter is electoral processes and filling elected positions, which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7).
